confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge and regional comparison; no live listings or price pages were consulted. Beer and restaurant anchors are better grounded. Cocktail and wine are inferred from the beer anchor (about 4x and 5x) because direct knowledge is weak. Accommodation is least certain and reflects July, an off-season month. The FX value (16 October) comes from RBA data as summarized in search results; the RBA page was not opened directly, and the figure is not independently confirmed beyond one third-party site.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city. Estimated from budget-to-mid-range Southeast Asian capital price levels (broadly the Phnom Penh and Hanoi tiers), placed at the lower end for Vientiane's smaller tourism market. No web sources were used for the city-price anchors.
